processing: FIRMS: rows grouped by acq_date+acq_time+satellite; no rows dropped; longitude bands are a display choice
IMERG: precipitation field cut to bbox -90,18,-78,32; 2x2 mean for display; statistics computed on the full 0.1 degree cells
OPERA: pixel counts per class over the whole mosaic; water area = water pixels x 900 m2
OPERA DSWx-S1: cut to the UTM 14N box 465-510 km E, 3310-3335 km N (Kerr County); water area = water pixels x 900 m2; thumbnail shows a 90 m block as water if any 30 m pixel in it is water
notInGame: None of these observations changes any score, target or event in the three missions. They are shown as labelled NASA observations in the Final Report and the Data & sources panel.
